name: Emotional Experiments
source:
Ada is in the final year of her PhD and has just started as an in intern at an AI startup. Follow her journey as she studies with her childhood friend, meets a shy artist, and works for a flirty CEO, all while attempting to create a sentient AI!

[From [url=https://steamed-buns.itch.io/emotional-experiments]Itch.io[/url]]
